timelineBlocks: 326 BC: Alexander invaded Indian subcontinent, and defeated Porus in the battle of Hydaspes (Jhelum)
712: Invasion of Sind by [Muhammad Bin Qasim](((vhAtmDLHy)))
1001: Battle of Peshawar, where Mahmud of Gahzni defeated Jayapala, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.
1001: Battle of Waihind, where Mahmud of Gahzni defeated Anandapapa, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.
1024: Mahmud of Gahzni invaded Solanki dynasty and plundered Somnath temple.
1191: Battle of terrain-I, where Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Muhammad Ghori
1192: Battle of terrain-II, where Prithviraj Chauhan was defeated by Mohammad Ghori and Delhi came under Muslims.
1194: Battle of Chandewar, where Mohammad Ghori defeated Jayachandra of the Gahadavala dynasty and captured Kannuj
1526: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat and founded the Mughal Empire in India.
1527: Babur defeated Rana Sanga of Mewar in the Battle of Khanwa and strengthened Mughal rule in north India.
1528: Babur defeated Medini Rai in the Battle of Chanderi and captured the fort to control Malwa region.
1529: Babur defeated the Afghans and Bengal forces in the Battle of Ghaghra and secured eastern territories.
1539: Humayun defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Chausa and lost control of Bihar region.
1540: Humayun again defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Kannauj and fled from India, ending early Mughal rule temporarily.
